verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm that provides attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software platform. Subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any programmatic interface: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and a newsletter signup is not a webhook.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
